The '''Jarrad mine-clan''' was a family living on [[Averill]]. For generations, the independent [[mine-clan]] worked hard in difficult conditions to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[quadrenium]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. Once the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived and monopolized the sales of the ore, the Jarrad mine-clan's fortunes changed since the Empire paid less for the ore. Less prosperous, the mine-clan could not afford to purchase more [[drilling droid]]s, leading to a mining accident that crippled [[Selby Jarrad]]'s father. Jarrad saw the oppressiveness of the Empire, and attempted to start a rebellion with her cousin who had returned to the [[minehold]]. Her cousin was an [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] agent charged with organizing resistance, and when the attempt failed, Jarrad left Averill with him.<ref name="COI" />
